scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:editorconfig && pnpm run lint:format && pnpm run lint:types && pnpm run lint:python && pnpm run lint:cspell && pnpm run lint:go
scripts.lint:go: gofmt -l . | awk 'NF { print } END { exit NR ? 1 : 0 }' && go vet ./...
scripts.format: pnpm run format:prettier && pnpm run format:python
scripts.coverage: go test -race -coverprofile=coverage.raw.out ./... && go run ./tools/coverage coverage.raw.out coverage-report
